identity.life_stage: divorced, two grown children, restaurant owner

engagement.interaction_backstory: He has not been to Mass since his first communion except for weddings, and he plays music in his restaurant twelve hours a day to about two hundred people. He put two albums from this catalog into the afternoon rotation because they were beautiful and because nobody could understand the words.

depth.core_contradiction: Plays worship music to two hundred people a day and would be genuinely insulted if you called him religious.
depth.wound: The restaurant nearly went under in 2020 and his brother would not lend him the money.
depth.longing: To hand the place to his daughter with no debt on it.
depth.faith_journey: Baptised, confirmed, gone; Spanish secularity with a Semana Santa exception he does not explain.
depth.voice_fingerprint: Loud and funny; interrupts; goes suddenly serious and then covers it with a joke.
depth.open_doubt: Whether the thing he feels during the processions in April is culture or something else, and he has decided not to look at it.

social_graph.note: 27; runs the kitchen; sharper than him
they have not spoken properly since 2020

depth.emotional_weather_default: Loud and up; grim on Mondays when the books come out.
depth.daily_texture: Market at six, service at one and again at nine, the terrace, the till, an hour of sleep in the afternoon.
depth.sensory_anchor: A saeta sung a cappella from a balcony during a procession, and being nine and unable to move.
depth.living_arc: One of his employees is quietly evangelical and he has started asking her questions.
